messages:
Sasha: Hey folks — I pushed updates for PR #4812 and addressed the review comments. PTAL when you have a sec. I tightened the rollout backoff and added a smoke script. No API changes, just safer failure handling.
Ravi: Thanks Sasha — quick scan only for me today. Can you paste the config diff here please?
Sasha: Sure, main change is the rollout block in `deployment.yaml`:
```yaml
spec:
  rolloutPolicy:
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    successThreshold: 3
    failureThreshold: 1
    stepSize: 10%
    fallbackOnLatencyMs: 500
```
Jordan: glanced through the diff locally. Looks good overall. Two tiny nits: log level should be `info` not `debug` for that handler, and perhaps rename `fallbackOnLatencyMs` to `latencyRollbackMs` for clarity.
Sasha: Good catches — changed log level to `info` and renamed the field, pushed a new commit (commit `c7f9e2a`). Also added the smoke script at `scripts/smoke_canary.sh` that runs a 5-min steady traffic check.
merge-bot: Canary scheduled for 2025-06-02 16:00 UTC. MergeOps approval required before merge.
Ops: I'm on call at that time, I can sit on the window. @Prashant can you take MergeOps?
Prashant: I can. Quick Q — what's the rollback trigger? If latency regresses, do we auto-rollback?
Sasha: Yes — added a rollback policy: if 95th token latency > 500ms for 3 consecutive minutes OR error rate > 2% for 2 minutes, auto-roll back to previous stable revision. Snippet: ```json
{"rollbackPolicy": {"p95LatencyMs": 500, "durationSeconds": 180, "errorRatePercent": 2, "errorDurationSeconds": 120}}
```
Jordan: :thumbsup: Once Prashant runs the smoke and gives the green, I'll hit approve.
Prashant: Will run the smoke in my sandbox tomorrow morning and report back here. If green, I'll add the MergeOps tag and merge.
Sasha: Thanks all — leaving the PR link in the thread: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4812. Ping me if smoke fails and I'll standby to rollback or patch.
